canonical_name: biRISC-V next-PC / branch prediction unit (biriscv_npc.v: BTB, bimodal or gshare, RAS; Ultra-Embedded)
lineage: Dynamic branch prediction (Smith 1981 bimodal; McFarling 1993 gshare; Yeh & Patt two-level) as one Verilog module inside a small dual-issue RISC-V core: a branch target buffer, a bimodal/gshare pattern table, a return-address stack. The DECISION machinery is small and its state (counters, history) is exposed; the vault's picorv32 has no predictor at all -- this is the contrasting design point.
version: github.com/ultraembedded/biriscv master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes); file src/core/biriscv_npc.v
entry_points: module biriscv_npc #(SUPPORT_BRANCH_PREDICTION, NUM_BTB_ENTRIES, NUM_BHT_ENTRIES, GSHARE_ENABLE, RAS_ENABLE)

example.command: iverilog -I src/core -o sim $HARNESS/tb_npc.v src/core/biriscv_npc.v && vvp sim
example.input: a synthetic branch stream: a loop branch taken N-1 times then not-taken, repeated
example.output: predicted next PC per cycle vs the actual outcome; misprediction count falls after warm-up (the trace)

upstream_docs: McFarling, Combining Branch Predictors, DEC WRL TN-36, 1993

human_capability_summary.built_to: guess the next instruction address before the branch resolves, so the pipeline never waits
human_capability_summary.pressure: pipeline depth (a wrong guess costs a flush), tiny tables, hidden program behaviour
human_capability_summary.success_means: misprediction rate falls to a few percent on loops; the RAS predicts returns exactly

human_environmental_pressure: hard timing bound (one guess per cycle), bounded table memory, hidden state (program control flow)
human_failure_condition: aliasing in the pattern table makes two branches poison each other's counters
behavioral_entry_point: shrink NUM_BHT_ENTRIES to force aliasing; toggle GSHARE_ENABLE; compare misprediction traces on the same branch stream

lineage_relations.note: RISC-V cores: one predicts, one does not

nyx_handoff.how_to_run_it: recipe.json (runner docker); python -m techne.fossils.harvest run biriscv-branch-predictor
nyx_handoff.what_humans_used_it_for: guess the next instruction address before the branch resolves, so the pipeline never waits
